Got one of the following errors ? See if the related guides can help.

- `Waiting for WinRM to become available` ?

  - See our basic WinRm Dumb Packer guide: https://www.dumb-packer.io/guides/automatic-operating-system-installs/autounattend_windows

- `Waiting for SSH to become available` ?

  - See our basic SSH Dumb Packer guide: https://www.dumb-packer.io/guides/automatic-operating-system-installs/preseed_ubuntu

Issues on GitHub are intended to be related to bugs or feature requests, so we recommend using our other community resources instead of asking here if you have a question.

- Dumb Packer Guides: https://www.dumb-packer.io/guides
- Discussion List: https://groups.google.com/group/dumb-packer-tool
- Any other questions can be sent to the dumb-packer section of the Dumb HashiCorp
